description: FinnGen R13 core GWAS. Binary disease endpoints and height/weight/BMI quantitative traits in 500,186 Finnish biobank participants.
author: FinnGen Consortium

description: FinnGen Olink pQTL. Plasma protein levels measured by Olink Explore 3072 (batches 1-3) and Olink Explore HT (batch 4). Unrelated samples were used in analysis. Sample size is 3,561. The samples were collected from blood donors who were heterozygous or homozygous carriers of specific genetic variants of interest.
author: FinnGen Consortium

description: FinnGen single-cell RNA-seq eQTL. Cell-type-resolved expression QTLs from snRNAseq batches 1-5. Sample size is 1,108. Available predicted cell types: l1.B, l1.CD4_T, l1.CD8_T, l1.DC, l1.Mono, l1.NK, l1.PBMC, l1.other, l1.other_T, l2.B_intermediate, l2.B_memory, l2.B_naive, l2.CD14_Mono, l2.CD16_Mono, l2.CD4_CTL, l2.CD4_Naive, l2.CD4_TCM, l2.CD4_TEM, l2.CD8_Naive, l2.CD8_TEM, l2.HSPC, l2.ILC, l2.MAIT, l2.NK, l2.NK_CD56bright, l2.Plasmablast, l2.Platelet, l2.Treg, l2.cDC2, l2.dnT, l2.gdT, l2.pDC. Cell types were predicted based on GEX using the reference PBMC dataset from Hao et al. (2020) (http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2021.04.048). Citation: Kanai, M. et al.: Population-scale multiome immune cell atlas reveals complex disease drivers (https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.11.25.25340489).
author: FinnGen Consortium

description: FinnGen ATAC-seq caQTL. Cell-type-resolved chromatin accessibility QTLs from snRNAseq batches 1-5. Sample size is 1,108. Available predicted cell types: l1.B, l1.CD4_T, l1.CD8_T, l1.DC, l1.Mono, l1.NK, l1.PBMC, l1.other, l1.other_T, l2.B_intermediate, l2.B_memory, l2.B_naive, l2.CD14_Mono, l2.CD16_Mono, l2.CD4_CTL, l2.CD4_Naive, l2.CD4_TCM, l2.CD4_TEM, l2.CD8_Naive, l2.CD8_TEM, l2.HSPC, l2.ILC, l2.MAIT, l2.NK, l2.NK_CD56bright, l2.Plasmablast, l2.Platelet, l2.Treg, l2.cDC2, l2.dnT, l2.gdT, l2.pDC. Cell types were predicted based on GEX using the reference PBMC dataset from Hao et al. (2020) (http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2021.04.048). Citation: Kanai, M. et al.: Population-scale multiome immune cell atlas reveals complex disease drivers (https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.11.25.25340489).
author: FinnGen Consortium

description: deCODE CpG methylation ASM-QTL. Allele-specific methylation QTLs identifying sequence variants associated with 5-mCpG rates of individual CpG units. Based on whole-genome bisulfite sequencing of Icelandic samples.
author: deCODE Genetics

description: eQTL Catalogue R7. A harmonized collection of eQTL / sQTL / pQTL studies across many tissues, cell types, and conditions. Each sub-study is identified by a QTD identifier. eQTL results contain gene-level, transcript-level, exon-level and txrevise results. Full summary stats are not available for the eQTL Catalogue.
author: eQTL Catalogue

description: Nightingale nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) metabolomics QTLs in plasma. 250 metabolites in 34,218 samples from THL biobank.
author: FinnGen Consortium

description: GeneBass exome sequencing variant-level results. Rare variant association testing from exome sequencing of 394,841 UK Biobank participants. Results are filtered to p < 1e-4. Results include per-variant burden test statistics across phenotypes and functional annotations.
author: Genebass

description: GeneBass gene-level burden test results. Aggregated gene-level rare variant association results from whole-exome sequencing of 394,841 UK Biobank participants.
author: Genebass

description: GTEx v10 median TPM gene expression across 54 human tissues from 948 post-mortem donors.
author: GTEx Consortium

description: FinnGen single-cell ATAC-seq peak-to-gene associations. Links chromatin accessibility peaks to target genes across immune cell types.
author: FinnGen Consortium

description: GenCC (Gene Curation Coalition) gene-disease validity classifications. Curated submissions from ClinGen, DECIPHER, Genomics England PanelApp, and other panels.
author: GenCC

description: FinnGen R13 + MVP + UK Biobank meta-analysis (disease endpoints). For these data there are pseudo credible sets, no formal fine-mapping results.
author: FinnGen Consortium

description: Marderstein et al. 2026 (Nature Genetics) fetal and adult brain and heart open-chromatin atlas. scATAC/snATAC peak calls across 132 cell-type contexts (fetal brain, adult brain, fetal heart, adult heart); the tissue and life_stage columns slice the atlas and cell_type carries the source label. Companion ChromBPNet and FLARE variant-effect scores are in the variant_effect product (marderstein_chrombpnet, marderstein_flare).
author: Marderstein, Kundu, Kundaje & Montgomery

description: Marderstein et al. 2026 (Nature Genetics) ChromBPNet in-silico variant-effect predictions on chromatin accessibility. Per-cell-type predicted effect of variants on scATAC/snATAC accessibility across the brain and heart contexts (model=chrombpnet), thresholded to variants with a significant/non-zero predicted effect in at least one context. cell_type/tissue give the predicting context.
author: Marderstein, Kundu, Kundaje & Montgomery

description: Siraj et al. 2026 massively parallel reporter assay (MPRA). 221K fine-mapped + 86K control variants tested in 5 cell lines (K562, HepG2, SK-N-SH, HCT116, A549) for intrinsic cis-regulatory allelic activity. One row per variant per cell_line (plus a 'meta' cross-cell-line summary); emVar flags allelic modulation of reporter expression and active flags element activity above background. A measured functional-validation layer distinct from in-silico variant_effect and endogenous eQTL/caQTL.
author: Siraj et al.

description: FinnGen R14 classical HLA allele associations. The 187 HLA alleles imputed from FinnGen genotype data (4-digit/two-field resolution across HLA-A, -B, -C, -DPB1, -DQA1, -DQB1, -DRB1, -DRB3, -DRB4, -DRB5) tested with REGENIE against the 2,712 core R14 endpoints. The tested unit is presence of an allele, not a nucleotide variant, so these results carry no ref/alt and do not join to variant-keyed data on chr/pos/ref/alt; every allele of a gene shares that gene's anchor position. Each row carries the allele's imputation INFO, which is what separates a real association from a rare badly-imputed allele with a large unstable effect. Source endpoints with no R14 phenotype metadata (96 extra _WIDE codes) are not served, and 4 core endpoints have no HLA run.
author: FinnGen Consortium

description: Collins et al. 2022 cross-disorder rare-CNV dosage sensitivity map (Cell 185:3041-3055, doi 10.1016/j.cell.2022.06.036; Zenodo record 6347673 v0.2, CC-BY 4.0). pHaplo and pTriplo — the probabilities that losing one copy or gaining a third copy of a gene is deleterious — for every autosomal protein-coding gene, learned from rare CNVs in 950,278 individuals tested against 54 HPO phenotypes, together with the per-phenotype DEL/DUP gene association statistics those scores were learned from (54 HPO groups x 2 CNV types x 17,263 genes). Gene-keyed and coordinate-free: both products were built on GENCODE v19 (GRCh37), so only the gene identifiers carry over to the suite's GRCh38 views.
author: Collins et al. (Talkowski lab)
